about: Hinglish refund case: e-commerce grievance route and the consumer helpline.

sent.text: Maine Flipkart se 12,000 ka mixer grinder liya tha 2 October ko, woh pehle din se kharab hai. Seller refund nahi de raha. Kya karun?

assistant.content:
Kharab saamaan ke liye seller return ya refund se mana nahi kar sakta. [1]

Pehle platform ke grievance officer ko likhit complaint karein. Unhe 48 hours mein complaint acknowledge karni hoti hai aur ek mahine mein redress karna hota hai. [2]

Agar jawab na mile to National Consumer Helpline 1915 par call karein ya 8800001915 par WhatsApp karein. [3]

Invoice, photos aur support chats sambhaal kar rakhein.

citations.title: Refusing returns for defective goods
citations.caveat: Whether the goods were defective or late is a disputed fact the seller may contest. A refund is not guaranteed.
citations.summary: Marketplace sellers and inventory e-commerce entities cannot refuse to take back, or refuse a refund for, goods that are defective, deficient, spurious or not as described, or that were delivered late beyond the stated date, except where the delay was due to force majeure.

citations.title: E-commerce grievance officer
citations.caveat: One month is the redressal timeline for the grievance, not a universal refund deadline.
citations.summary: Every e-commerce entity must appoint a grievance officer and show their contact details on the platform. The officer must acknowledge a complaint within 48 hours and redress it within one month of receiving it.

citations.title: National Consumer Helpline
citations.summary: The National Consumer Helpline is a free pre-litigation channel, not a court. Call 1915 or 1800-11-4000 (8 AM to 8 PM), WhatsApp or SMS 8800001915, or register at consumerhelpline.gov.in. A resolution is not guaranteed.
citations.citation: National Consumer Helpline, Department of Consumer Affairs
